svg.title: First success per onboarding milestone, per arm, against cumulative tokens on a log scale — Run 6, knowledge delivery wave 1. All four arms reached all seven milestones, so the not-reached gutter is empty: Sonnet 5 control within 4.42M tokens, Sonnet 5 pushed within 5.09M, gpt-5.2 control within 7.45M, gpt-5.2 pushed within 5.46M. Every point falls in the left third of the same axis on which Runs 1, 2, 4 and 5 ran out to 30 to 90 million tokens. Three bridge points fall below the 0.1M axis minimum and are plotted at the axis edge.
